title: 第11章 柳芭奇卡上线第12章 进入防空洞
slug: 废墟探险家第325章回魂芭
content_zh:
“年轻人们，该我问了。”
个头不大的锁匠抛出了他的问题，“首先，能不能给我再来两罐咖啡？其次，你们这次要打开的是什么锁？”
“不知道是什么锁，大概率是保险箱。”
虞娓娓在白芑拿出两罐咖啡递给对方的同时说道，“但是里面有我们需要的纸质材料，大概还会有易碎的玻璃制品。
所以开锁的时候虽然可以毁掉保险箱，但是不能破坏里面保存的东西。”
“无论是纸质文件还是玻璃制品，任何一样因为开锁被损坏，你的侄子都会被立刻送回监狱完成他的刑期。”负责开车的塔拉斯补充道。
“但是保险箱的锁可以破坏对吧？”锁匠问道。
“当然”塔拉斯和虞娓娓以及柳芭三人异口同声的说道。
“我有多久的开锁时间？”锁匠追问道。
“最多三天时间”虞娓娓给出了一个格外宽厚的时间。
“问题不大”锁匠自信的说道，他还没遇到三天的时间都撬不开的锁。
“哥哥，我们还有多久才能赶到目的地？”柳芭却在这个时候问道，“我饿了”。
“出发之前你该多吃些东西的”
塔拉斯说着，已经抄起了车载电台的咪头，用白芑听不懂的语言说了些什么，同时也缓缓降低车速最终又一次停在了路边。
很快，一直在前面的那辆面包车车门打开，一个身高能有一米八左右的长发女人拎着一个纸盒走了过来。
“妮可姐姐，麻烦你了。”
先一步打开车门的虞娓娓道了声谢，同时也接过了那个纸盒子。
“不用客气”
这个身材惊艳长相绝对符合绝大多数欧洲人审美的金发女人问道，“你们谁要吃华夏泡面？我们带了很多口味。”
“请给我一份儿”锁匠根本不知道客气的说道。

“我也要！”柳芭立刻说道，“我要最辣的！”
“我和柳芭吃一份就好”
虞娓娓跟着说道，“她自己吃不完一份的，我也不是很饿。”
“我要不辣的”锁匠后知后觉的补充道。
“奥列格先生呢？”被虞娓娓称作妮可的女人看向白芑。
“我也来一份吧”白芑说道，“随便什么口味都可以。”
“亲爱的，你呢？”妮可最后朝驾车的塔拉斯问道，“还是三块面饼吗？”
“没错”塔拉斯说道。
“请稍等一会儿”
妮可说完，转身走向了前面那辆车子，柳芭也迫不及待的打开了妮可刚刚送来的纸盒子，这里面全都是诸如蛋挞之类的小甜品。
“请不要客气，都尝尝吧，这些都是我妻子在出发前亲手做的。”
塔拉斯接过柳芭递给他的一个蛋挞，同时热情的发出了邀请。
“你有这么漂亮的拉脱维亚妻子简直和你的身高一样让人羡慕”锁匠拿起一个蛋挞的同时说道。
“妮可姐姐以前是个超模呢！”
柳芭得意的说道，就好像那是她的妻子似的。
“你怎么知道她是拉脱维亚人？”虞娓娓和塔拉斯同时注意到了这句话里的细节。
content_en:
"Young men, it's my turn to ask."
The small locksmith asked his question, "First of all, can you bring me two more cans of coffee? Secondly, what lock are you trying to open this time?"
"I don't know what kind of lock it is, but it's most likely a safe."
When Bai Qi took out two cans of coffee and handed them to the other party, Yu Weiwei said, "But there are paper materials we need in them, and there are probably fragile glass products.
Therefore, although the safe can be destroyed when opening the lock, the contents stored inside cannot be destroyed. "
"Whether it is paper documents or glass products, if anything is damaged due to unlocking, your nephew will be immediately sent back to prison to complete his sentence." Talas, who was responsible for driving, added.
"But the lock on the safe can be broken, right?" the locksmith asked.
"Of course" Taras, Yu Weiwei and Liuba said in unison.
"How long do I have to open the lock?" the locksmith asked.
"At most three days" Yu Weiwei gave an extra generous time.
"It's not a big problem," the locksmith said confidently. He had never encountered a lock that couldn't be picked in three days.
"Brother, how long will it take for us to reach our destination?" Liuba asked at this time, "I'm hungry."
"You should eat more before setting off."
As Taras spoke, he had already picked up the microphone of the car radio and said something in a language that Bai Qi couldn't understand. At the same time, he slowly slowed down the speed of the car and finally stopped on the side of the road again.
Soon, the door of the van that had been in front opened, and a long-haired woman about 1.8 meters tall came over carrying a cardboard box.
"Sister Nicole, please excuse me."
Yu Wei, who opened the car door first, thanked her and took the paper box at the same time.
“You’re welcome”
This blond woman with a stunning figure and an appearance that definitely fits the aesthetics of most Europeans asked, "Which of you wants to eat Chinese instant noodles? We have brought many flavors."
"Please give me a share," the locksmith said politely, not knowing how to do it.
"I want it too!" Liuba said immediately, "I want the hottest one!"
"Liuba and I will just have one."
Yu Weiwei followed, "She can't finish one portion by herself, and I'm not very hungry either."
"I want something spicy," the locksmith added in hindsight.
"Where's Mr. Oleg?" The woman named Nicole by Yu Weiwei looked at Bai Zhi.
"I'll have one too," Bai Qi said, "Any flavor is fine."
"Honey, what about you?" Nicole finally asked Taras who was driving, "Are you still three pancakes?"
"That's right," Taras said.
"Please wait a moment"
After Nicole finished speaking, she turned and walked towards the car in front of her. Liuba couldn't wait to open the paper box that Nicole just sent. It was full of small desserts such as egg tarts.
"Please don't be polite, please try them all. My wife made these by herself before departure."
Taras took an egg tart handed to him by Liuba and extended an invitation warmly.
"You have such a beautiful Latvian wife who is as enviable as your height," the locksmith said while picking up an egg tart.
"Sister Nicole used to be a supermodel!"
Lyuba said proudly, as if that was her wife.
"How do you know she is Latvian?" Yu Weiwei and Taras noticed the details in this sentence at the same time.
